messages:
Aisha Khan: quick RFC follow-up — thinking out loud about a lightweight hint to help clients and routing make safe rollback/gating decisions without strong server locks. sketch below. feedback pls :thinking:

Aisha Khan: ```json
{
  "rollout_metadata": {
    "locking_hint": "soft", // enum: soft | hard | none
    "rollback_grace_seconds": 600,
    "lease_ttl_seconds": 3600,
    "fallback_priority": ["v2-quant", "v2-fp16", "v1"],
    "client_probe_hint": {
      "expected_prefixes":  ["/chat/"],
      "min_compat_score": 0.9
    }
  }
}
```

Matt B.: I like the ergonomics, but worried about clients ignoring `locking_hint`. if clients treat `soft` as advisory they might still trigger flapping when rollbacks happen. how do we prevent cascading rollbacks?

Jamal R.: two ideas: 1) server-side backoff window when rollout changes that suppresses immediate hard rollbacks, 2) record a small vector in the pin metadata that clients can use to detect transient flips (eg. `last_changed_ts`).

Priya S.: +1 on `last_changed_ts`. also can we make `locking_hint: hard` imply server-enforced lease semantics (reject conflicting pins for N seconds)? otherwise `hard` means little.

Matt B.: agreed — defaults matter. unknown/absent `locking_hint` should be treated as `none`. and we should expose telemetry counters when clients ignore hints so we can tune. :mag_right:

Aisha Khan: proposal: keep hints advisory by default, but allow tenants to opt-in to enforcement flags for Dedicated/Private via a `pin_enforcement` toggle in tenant config. enforcement would: 1) reject new competing pins for `lease_ttl_seconds`, 2) surface conflict errors to client SDKs with code `PinConflictError`.

Priya S.: question: what about rollouts that need gradual canary vs atomic switchover? hints need a `grace_window` that plays nicely with canaries. maybe add `grace_strategy: progressive|atomic` plus `grace_window_seconds`?

Aisha Khan: good call. updated sketch: `grace_strategy` + `grace_window_seconds`. progressive means routing will lower traffic to old variant over window instead of immediate eviction.

Jamal R.: operational concern: how do we surface the actual lifetime of an effective pin to ops? suggest adding `effective_until_ts` computed server-side and returned in admin APIs/telemetry. helps on-call avoid surprises.

Matt B.: +1. Also add a minimal fingerprint field to pin (content-hash) so clients can detect no-op re-uploads vs real changes. avoids churn if only presentation metadata changed.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout/2026-03-pin-migration started by @aisha — note: rollout metadata update will be live in ~3m :rocket:

Aisha Khan: plan for migration: 1) backfill existing pins with `locking_hint: none` and `fingerprint` derived from model ref, 2) patch SDKs to respect `PinConflictError` and surface retry/backoff helpers, 3) opt-in enforcement for Dedicated tenants first.

Priya S.: sounds reasonable. can we add a short doc snippet in the rollout API describing enforcement semantics? ops + sdk teams need clear error codes.

Aisha Khan: yes — I'll draft a short follow-up RFC section and a one-pager for SDK/ops. thanks everyone :pray:
